result.summary: Found several visual issues: a broken promo badge showing '-0%', a truncated restaurant name in the carousel, and inconsistent delivery-fee styling across sections.

issues.description: The lower restaurant card shows a badge reading '-0%', which looks broken or like a failed discount calculation rather than a meaningful offer.
issues.suggestion: Hide the badge when the discount is 0%, or show a valid promo (e.g. a real percentage off or free delivery) instead of '-0%'.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card title is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' with no ellipsis, so the restaurant name is cut off mid-word.
issues.suggestion: Ensure card titles use ellipsis overflow (text-overflow: ellipsis) or wrap so names are not abruptly clipped.

issues.description: Delivery fee presentation is inconsistent: small cards use '€0.90 delivery' under the name while the popular card uses a floating '€0 delivery' pill on the image plus inline '€0 delivery' in the meta line.
issues.suggestion: Standardize delivery-fee badges and meta text across card types for a more cohesive UI.
